main.summary: Identifies how a resumable client upload session can reopen or interpret its finite content source.

value.name: None
value.summary: No persisted source descriptor is available.

value.name: ExternalFile
value.summary: The source is an explicit stable file path owned outside the client working directory.

value.name: WorkingDirectoryCopy
value.summary: The source is the staged finite stream copy persisted inside the client working directory.
